title: Kim
author: Rudyard Kipling
summary: Kim, an orphan boy living on the streets of British India, becomes the disciple of a Tibetan lama seeking a holy river and is also drawn into the Great Game of espionage along the roads of the Raj.
readIf: you enjoy old-fashioned adventure with vivid scenes of colonial India.
skipIf: you are put off by colonial-era attitudes or slow, episodic plotting.
